description: This file defines the core class 'SugarWidget' which serves as a base class for widget components in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It provides methods for widget identification, display, and management of properties such as widget ID, parent bean, and layout manager.

classes.name: SugarWidget
classes.description: A base class for creating widgets in the CRM framework, providing methods for display, ID management, and property handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the widget with a reference to the layout manager.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string; intended to be overridden by subclasses for custom display.

methods.name: getParentBean
methods.description: Retrieves the parent bean associated with the widget.

methods.name: setParentBean
methods.description: Associates a parent bean with the widget.

methods.name: getTruncatedColumnAlias
methods.description: Generates a truncated and hashed column alias to ensure it does not exceed 28 characters.
